stem: A business customer bought 30 laptops listed at €800 and 60 docking stations listed at €150. It paid €720 per laptop and €135 per docking station on the invoice, and after the quarter it received a rebate of €24 per laptop and €6 per docking station. Price realisation is 100 × what Voltmarkt keeps after on-invoice discounts and off-invoice rebates / list value. What was the price realisation on this customer for the quarter? Give a percentage with 1 decimal.
